facts.fact: 当晚 JulesPublicAccessAfterworld 的视频再次出现在 Bethany 的队列里；这次 Jules 宣布被 David Sawyer 本人邀请进入游戏的 final level，只剩最后一个 challenge，完成后就 “on my way to Public Access Afterworld”。
facts.anchor: “I’ve been invited to the final level of the game by David Sawyer himself. That means I’ve got just one more challenge. It’s a hard one, but once I complete it, I’ll be going there. I’ll finally be on my way to Public Access Afterworld…”

facts.fact: 背景：Public Access Afterworld 是 Jules 视频里反复念叨的 cult；其创始人 David Sawyer 是比两个 Ted（Bundy 与 Kaczynski）加起来还臭名昭著的 serial killer、网络最爱的 boogeyman；过去十五年这个 cult 长成了 minor cultural phenomenon。
facts.anchor: He was famous, a serial killer more notorious than both Teds combined (Bundy and Kaczynski). David Sawyer: an urban legend who was also real. David Sawyer: the internet’s favorite boogeyman.

facts.fact: Jules 说这最后一个 challenge 很大、“no going back from this”，需要时间准备、理解这场牺牲有多 real；随后卷起右袖、拆开新 razor blade 划过手臂：“Soon I’m finally going to be leaving this world behind.”
facts.anchor: “I’m nervous, but I’m excited,” they said as they dragged the blade across their arm. “Soon I’m finally going to be leaving this world behind.”

facts.fact: 这次 Bethany 忍住没按红按钮——再把这个陌生人的 cry for help 送进深渊让她太内疚（被 red-button 的用户只是不能再用同一邮箱注册，换个新邮箱就能回来；封禁显然没用、也没帮助）。
facts.anchor: As Bethany watched, she resisted the urge to toggle her mouse over to the red button on her admin panel like last time. She felt too guilty sending this stranger’s cry for help away into the abyss once again.

facts.fact: Jules 让 Bethany 想起自己：如果当年没离开 Harlingen（Texas–Mexico 边境的 dead-end hometown），她可能就是 Jules——那时她叫 Noah，也曾 self-harm（作为夺回控制感的方式）。
facts.anchor: Jules, whoever and wherever they were, reminded Bethany of herself. Of the person she might have been if she’d never gotten out of Harlingen, her dead-end hometown down on the Texas–Mexico border. Back there, when she’d been Noah, she too had flirted with self-harm.

facts.fact: Jules 的上传结束后，Bethany 让视频从头重放，用手机翻录了笔记本屏幕上 Jules 自残的短视频，然后走到 Douglas 那间电话亭大小的办公室门口敲门。
facts.anchor: After Jules’s upload ended, Bethany let it autoplay again from the start. Then she took out her cellphone and recorded a short camera video of her laptop screen, capturing Jules’s self-harm.

facts.fact: Douglas 只重申规则（self-harm 属 Code of Conduct 违规、违规按红按钮、黄按钮上报 manager 但别常按），说 “a lot of people on GlobalVill.com have suicidal ideation”、决定谁需要心理帮助 “not our place”，把她推给 HR 提供的免费 confidential counseling。
facts.anchor: “The thing is,” Douglas said, “a lot of people on GlobalVill.com have suicidal ideation, but just as many people don’t. Listen. The point is, it’s not our place to decide who needs mental help.

facts.fact: 回到座位后 Bethany 决定自己帮 Jules：google “JulesPublicAccessAfterworld” 只返回 GlobalVill.com 链接；她从 admin panel 进入网站 backend 查看 Jules 的机密 demographic 资料（FULL NAME/LOCATION/IP ADDRESS/EMAIL 全部打码），弹窗提示她的账号无权限查看；最后她转而 google “Public Access Afterworld”。
facts.anchor: Bethany clicked a button on her admin panel to enter the backend of GlobalVill’s website. She felt like a hacker as she navigated to Jules’s admin page and scrolled down to the boxes that contained confidential demographic information.
